scope: Nine base batches and nine completed 20M panels (including three audit-expansion queries) plus seventy-one prior followup queries. Pending Batch 09 new alternatives not counted. Mac, pilots and abandoned transition costs remain separate.
limits: Measured VM lifetimes priced at recorded rate, not billing. Mean scaling only; panel sizes, discovered alternatives and availability vary. Inclusive scenarios retain ancillary storage/transfer/operations and recovery assumptions. Cloud-stage timing excludes preflight, retrieval, review pauses and final synthesis.

calendar_estimate.games_and_batch_analysis: Friday evening, approximately 20:00–22:00 CET under stated assumptions
calendar_estimate.final_independently_reviewed_diagnosis: Friday night–Saturday morning, approximately Friday 22:00–Saturday 03:00 CET centrally; extended review may use more of Saturday morning
calendar_estimate.basis: The final base batch and its panel have a mean cloud estimate of 2.76 hours. Add bounded pending Batch 09 followup and assumed workflow/review time to obtain roughly 4–6 hours from this snapshot through final batch analysis. Then allow 2–4 hours for final synthesis and independent challenge. The three-query expansion has completed and is not pending. Larger recent panels justify retaining uncertainty around the mean. Allowances are assumptions, not service guarantees.
calendar_estimate.uncertainty: New alternatives, regional stockouts or substantive final-review findings can extend these windows; no coverage is truncated to meet an ETA.
